problem_statement: Lab results from the request queue are no longer reaching the patient portal: since portal_client moved to the v2 releases endpoint, labportal/release_handlers.py still calls the removed v1 methods push_result / push_amendment and every release fails with AttributeError. Please migrate the release handler to PortalClient.release(ReleaseRequest(...)), following the example in reference/release_handlers_v2.py. Final and amended results both go through the single release() call now, and release.completed should carry the release_id from the receipt. The clinician-review hold must keep working. tests/test_release_handlers.py describes the expected behaviour.
